latest_release.name: RepoPrompt CE 1.9.0
latest_release.body:
## RepoPrompt CE 1.9.0

### Highlights
- Redesigned Agent Mode sidebar with Chats and Overseers tabs, nested overseen sessions, improved header controls, and direct navigation from Overseer badges.
- Claude Code turns that start on their own are now visible and controllable as ordinary agent runs.
- Re-prompt uses recent conversation context and the session title, preserves in-flight rewrites across session switches, and waits for the correct composer before auto-sending.
- Session activation focuses pending questions or the composer while preserving live typing and keeping Return away from pending approvals.

### Reliability and polish
- Preserve unreadable workspace data and require a verified backup before recovery can replace it; decode compose tabs individually and persist per-window MCP tools preferences.
- Persist CodeMap root pause settings and bound indexing, bootstrap, and headless connection waits with actionable errors.
- Fix cold-session Codex compaction, resolve model menus from one catalog snapshot, and correct Claude context-window capacity handling.
- Improve mixed RTL/LTR Markdown lists and tables, prevent recursive tooltip sizing, show completed Oracle duration, and improve Debug profile persistence and settings scrolling.
- Improve CI recovery, queue diagnostics, and Tip publication while retaining separate release-artifact qualification.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/repoprompt/repoprompt-ce/compare/v1.8.1...v1.9.0
